title: Certify v0.1.2: erratum to the Part A note — Theorem D fiber count over {Delta_2 = 0} corrected to three distinct points; achievable fiber sizes {3,1,0}
description: Erratum release for the Part A preprint (Degree minimality in the equivariant class of the Alpoge Keller map, and the moment-map structure of its cotangent lift; v0.1.0/v0.1.1, doi:10.5281/zenodo.21799112). Releases v0.1.0 and v0.1.1 stated that the fiber of the map drops to two points over the pullback of {Delta_2 = 0}. This is wrong: that fiber has three distinct points; {Delta_2 = 0} is an apparent branch locus (Delta_2 enters squared in disc = -4 Delta_1 Delta_2^2), and the achievable set-theoretic fiber sizes are exactly {3, 1, 0} — consistent with the previously published 3/1/0 counts (ulam.ai Thm 4.2; Mayner; Shaska), which are credited, not claimed. The correction was independently re-verified in exact arithmetic from the raw map by newly written scripts (scripts/erratum-check/), and a repository-wide check confirmed no other claim depended on the erroneous value. Full statement: paper/ERRATUM-v0.1.2.md. This version supersedes v0.1.0/v0.1.1 on this point only.
